title: Holiness unto the Lord
old_p1: Zechariah told about the day Jesus comes again. He said, “The Lord shall be king over all the earth.” The Lord is Jesus.
On that day, the horses’ little bells will have these words on them: “Holiness unto the Lord.” Holy means very special to Heavenly Father.
Even the cooking pots will be holy, like the bowls by the altar. An altar is a special table for gifts to the Lord.
old_p2: Zechariah spoke of bells and pots because people used them every day. Everyday things can be holy too! Today, “Holiness to the Lord” is written on temples.
Your everyday things can be used for the Lord too. Tonight, look around your room and think of one thing you can use for Him tomorrow.
p1: Zechariah told about the day Jesus comes again as King. “The Lord shall be king over all the earth,” he said.
Even the horses’ bells will say, “Holiness unto the Lord.” Something holy belongs to Heavenly Father and is special to Him.
Even the cooking pots will be holy, like the bowls at the Lord’s house.
p2: Why bells and pots? People used them every day. Zechariah was teaching that everyday things can be holy too.
A spoon stirring soup for a sick friend is for the Lord too. Tonight, pick one thing in your room to use for Him tomorrow.
